reason: My kid's birthday is in the next few months and this place doesn't open until next year, so I can't book it for this one. The price is fair for hosted setup and cleanup, but I can't commit to a venue that isn't open yet.
objection: It isn't open yet, and I can't tell if the glass room fits our family and friends. Up to 12 kids doesn't say how many parents and grandparents can be in there too.
would_change_my_mind: An open date before my party and a stated room capacity that includes adults, ideally with a chance to see the room first.
